# Shepherd of Hermas Chapter 24 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)

**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Codex Sinaiticus (ch 1-31) / P.Mich. 130 (ch 32+), Shepherd of Hermas 24 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-EC/SHE_024_page_001.jpg

---

## Vision 4, Chapter 3

**1** I asked her to explain the four colors on the beast's head. She smiled. "More questions!" "Yes, please — tell me." **2** "The black stands for this present world you're living in. **3** The fiery blood-red means this world will be destroyed through blood and fire. **4** The golden part — that's you and all those who escape this world. Think of how gold is refined by fire and becomes pure and useful. You are undergoing the same process as you live in this world. Those who endure and pass through the fire will be purified. Just as gold sheds its impurities, you will shed all your grief and anguish — you'll come out purified and ready for the building of the tower. **5** The white part is the age to come, where God's chosen will live. Those whom God has chosen will be spotless and pure, and that future life will be filled with light. **6** So keep speaking these things to the saints — keep getting these words into their ears. You have been shown a preview of the coming great tribulation, but if you are willing to face it, it will pass like nothing. Remember what you've been shown." **7** After saying this she left. I couldn't tell which way she went — there was a noise, and I spun around in fright, thinking the beast was coming back.

---

*PNEUMA note: The involuntary fright at the end (v.7) is a beautifully human moment — the faith required to face the beast doesn't eliminate fear, it transcends it. Hermas remains human throughout.*
